scripts.deploy: npm run build:cloudflare && npm run deploy:worker
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:generate && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/ChurchLiveCaption.xcodeproj -scheme ChurchLiveCaption -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:test: npm run ios:generate && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/ChurchLiveCaption.xcodeproj -scheme ChurchLiveCaption -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO test
scripts.ios:archive:unsigned: npm run ios:generate && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/ChurchLiveCaption.xcodeproj -scheme ChurchLiveCaption -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath ios/build/ChurchLiveCaption.xcarchive -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO archive
scripts.ios:archive: npm run ios:generate && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/ChurchLiveCaption.xcodeproj -scheme ChurchLiveCaption -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath ios/build/ChurchLiveCaption.xcarchive -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData -xcconfig ios/Config/Signing.xcconfig -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
scripts.validate: npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 && npm run typecheck:strict && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run build:cloudflare && npm run deploy:check && git diff --check
